title: Restriction of a global normalized sheet coordinate equation
statement: Fix a prime $l$, a finite-dimensional totally disconnected normed $\mathbf Q_l$-extension $E$, and $A=\operatorname{continuousIntegers}(l,E)$ [def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients]. Let $X,U,Y$ be schemes, $p:U\to X$ and $g:Y\to X$ scheme morphisms, $P$ an internal continuous $E$-module on $X$, $M$ an internal continuous $A$-module on $U$, and $e:\operatorname{Ext}(M)\cong p^*P$. Let $d$ be a natural number and $t_j:Y\to U$ for $j\in\operatorname{Fin}(d)$ with specified equalities $w_j:t_jp=g$. Use the actual normalized sheet maps of [def-sfb-finite-etale-lattice-sheet-maps]. No freeness is assumed. Fix $r$, a continuous-function presentation [def-sfb-continuous-function-module-presentation] $c$ of $\operatorname{Res}(g^*P)$ by $E^r$, and presentations $b_j$ of $t_j^*M$ by $A^r$. Let $G_j:|Y|\to\operatorname{Mat}_{r\times r}(E)$ be arbitrary functions. Suppose for every pro-etale $B/Y$, section $x$, and $z\in|B|$, $c(f_j(x))(z)=G_j(B\to Y(z))b_j(x)(z)$, where $f_j$ is the normalized sheet map. Then for every open $W\subseteq Y$ there are presentations $c_W,b_{j,W}$ of the pullbacks along $W\to Y\to X$ and $W\to Y\to U$, and composition proofs $w_j^W$, for which the same formula holds for the actual normalized sheet map on $W$, with matrix $G_j(W\to Y(B\to W(z)))$. There is no assumption or conclusion about freeness, constructing matrices, matrix continuity or matrix invertibility.

proof.text: For the open immersion W→Y, restrict the given presentations to test objects over W, using continuousRing_module_restriction for A and E and the coefficient scalar-restriction comparison. Precomposition gives the restriction and scalar-action laws for the new coordinate maps.

Commute scalar restriction with pullback by comapUpperStarIso and identify the composed rational and integral pullbacks by upperStarComp. The composition equation for comapUpperStarIso, together with the associativity of upperStarComp and naturality on latticeIntegralEmbedding, identifies the transported global sheet map with the exact normalized finiteEtaleLatticeSheetEmbedding for W.ι≫t_j and W.ι≫g.

Set w_j^W using associativity and w_j. Apply the global coordinate equation to each test object regarded over Y. Its structure morphism is W.ι composed with the structure morphism to W, which is exactly the required argument of G_j. This also applies to rank zero, no sheets and empty W.

theorem continuousSheet_coordinate_restriction
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type) [NormedField E]
    [NormedAlgebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    [TotallyDisconnectedSpace E] {X U Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (P : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) X))
    (p : U ⟶ X)
    (M : Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology U) Ab.{u + 1})
      (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff l E) U))
    (e : (Mod.extendScalars (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap l E) U)).obj M ≅
      (upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) p).obj P)
    (g : Y ⟶ X) (d : ℕ) (t : Fin d → (Y ⟶ U)) (w : ∀ j, t j ≫ p = g)
    (r : ℕ)
    (c : ContinuousFunctionPresentation Y (continuousIntegers l E)
        (Fin r → E) ((Mod.comap (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap l E) Y)).obj
          ((upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) g).obj P)))
    (b : ∀ j, ContinuousFunctionPresentation Y (continuousIntegers l E)
        (Fin r → continuousIntegers l E) ((upperStar (integralCoeff l E) (t j)).obj M))
    (G : Fin d → Y → Matrix (Fin r) (Fin r) E)
    (h : ∀ (j : Fin d) (B : Y.ProEt)
      (x : ((continuousRingModuleEquivalence Y (continuousIntegers l E)).functor.obj
          ((upperStar (integralCoeff l E) (t j)).obj M)).val.obj (op B)) (z : B.left),
      c.sections B
        (((continuousRingModuleEquivalence Y (continuousIntegers l E)).functor.map
            (finiteEtaleLatticeSheetEmbedding (integralScalarMap l E) P p M e
              g (t j) (w j))).val.app (op B) x) z =
        G j (B.hom z) *ᵥ (fun i ↦ ((b j).sections B x z i : E))) :
      ∀ W : Y.Opens, ∃ w' : ∀ j, (W.ι ≫ t j) ≫ p = W.ι ≫ g,
        ∃ c : ContinuousFunctionPresentation W.toScheme (continuousIntegers l E)
            (Fin r → E) ((Mod.comap
              (coefficientMap (integralScalarMap l E) W.toScheme)).obj
              ((upperStar (Profinite.continuousMapRingObj E) (W.ι ≫ g)).obj P)),
        ∃ b : ∀ j, ContinuousFunctionPresentation W.toScheme (continuousIntegers l E)
            (Fin r → continuousIntegers l E)
            ((upperStar (integralCoeff l E) (W.ι ≫ t j)).obj M),
        ∀ (j : Fin d) (B : W.toScheme.ProEt)
          (x : ((continuousRingModuleEquivalence W.toScheme
            (continuousIntegers l E)).functor.obj
            ((upperStar (integralCoeff l E) (W.ι ≫ t j)).obj M)).val.obj (op B))
          (z : B.left),
          c.sections B
            (((continuousRingModuleEquivalence W.toScheme
              (continuousIntegers l E)).functor.map
              (finiteEtaleLatticeSheetEmbedding (integralScalarMap l E) P p M e
                (W.ι ≫ g) (W.ι ≫ t j) (w' j))).val.app (op B) x) z =
            G j (W.ι (B.hom z)) *ᵥ
              (fun i ↦ ((b j).sections B x z i : E))
